Venue: Gate
Headline: Trenches 7-Day Check-in Sprint Phase 4: Get 2 USDT Daily, Up to 101 USDT per User

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Trenches 7-Day Check-in Sprint Phase 4 is now live. During the campaign, trade Ethereum chain tokens in the Trenches zone to unlock three rewards: Returning User Exclusive, Daily Check-in, and Trading Airdrop. Share a total prize pool of 20,000 USDT. All three rewards can be claimed together.
Click "Join Now" to register first, then trade Ethereum chain tokens in the Trenches zone to become eligible for rewards.
Join Now
## Campaign Period: November 27, 2026, 08:00 – December 4, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## Campaign Scope
All Ethereum chain tokens in the Trenches zone. Both buy and sell trades count toward trading volume.
## Reward 1: 10 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher for Returning Users
Returning users who trade Ethereum chain tokens in the Trenches zone during the campaign and reach a cumulative trading volume (buy and sell combined) of 100 USDT will receive a 10 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher. Total pool: 10,000 USDT. Limited to 1 voucher per user, distributed in order of qualification, while supplies last.
This reward is exclusive to returning users. Returning users are those who have previously traded on Gate Trenches (including the former Gate Alpha) and have not traded on Trenches in the 7 days before the campaign starts. Returning users may also participate in Rewards 2 and 3.
## Reward 2: Daily Check-in, Get a 2 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher Every Day
During the campaign, registered users who trade Ethereum chain tokens in the Trenches zone and reach a daily trading volume (buy and sell combined) of 400 USDT will complete that day's check-in and receive a 2 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher. Each user can receive this reward up to once per day. Total pool: 5,000 USDT. Rewards are distributed automatically on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
## Reward 3: Trading Airdrop, Up to 11.28 GT
During the campaign, registered users who trade Ethereum chain tokens in the Trenches zone and reach the specified cumulative trading volume tiers (buy and sell combined) will unlock the GT reward for each tier. Each tier's task and reward pool are independent, and rewards can be stacked, up to 11.28 GT in total. Total pool: approximately 5,000 USDT. Rewards are distributed automatically on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
Cumulative Trading Volume (USDT) | Reward per User (GT) | Estimated Value (USDT) | Quota (Users)
2,000 | 0.75 | 5 | 400
10,000 | 3.01 | 20 | 75
25,000 | 7.52 | 50 | 30
## Notice
Users must complete identity verification to claim rewards.
Only trading volume generated after successful registration and during the campaign period will be counted. Trades made before registration do not count. Trading volume that does not meet the daily check-in threshold still counts toward cumulative trading volume.
Daily check-ins are calculated based on calendar days in UTC+0. Users can claim the reward on any day they meet the threshold, and consecutive check-ins are not required.
Rewards from this campaign cannot be combined with other campaigns, and rewards from campaigns of the same type cannot be stacked.
Please verify the token name, chain, and contract address before trading. If any token information is incorrect, please contact customer support.
Campaign page data will be updated within 1–2 hours. Displayed data is for reference only, and final results will be calculated according to the campaign rules.
Rewards for Reward 2 and Reward 3 will be distributed automatically to users' accounts once the corresponding tasks are completed. If a reward is not received, it means the rewards have run out or the user does not meet the task requirements.
The reward values listed for Reward 3 are estimates for reference only. Airdrops will be distributed as Trenches token mystery boxes. Token prices may fluctuate, and the actual rewards received shall prevail.
Fee Rebate Vouchers must be activated before use and cannot be withdrawn or transferred. Applicable markets, rebate ratios, and validity periods are subject to the voucher details.
First-time Trenches users must follow the on-page instructions to accept the innovation trading disclaimer and relevant user agreements. Token projects may carry significant risks and price volatility. Please participate with caution.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person's identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
In case of any discrepancy between different language versions, the English version shall prevail.
Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this campaign and may adjust the terms or cancel the campaign without prior notice.
Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions are not eligible to participate. For details, please refer to the User Agreement. This campaign is not intended to solicit or market to users in restricted regions.

Headline: Gate Research: BTC Consolidates Above 60,000 USDT, U.S. Bitcoin ETF Monthly Net Outflows Surpass the...

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Stock Market: U.S. stock markets were closed on November 26 for Thanksgiving. In the previous trading session, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell 0.25% and 0.62%, respectively, while the Dow Jones rose 0.33% and Nvidia declined 3.91%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index and Hang Seng TECH Index gained 1.19% and 1.16%, respectively. South Korea's KOSPI and KOSDAQ advanced 0.29% and 0.78%, respectively. The Bank of Korea raised its benchmark rate to 3.25%.
Market Commentary: BTC traded at 60,736.6 USDT and ETH at 1,699.89 USDT, both up 0.26% over the past 24 hours, but a reversal of their medium-term weakness remained unconfirmed. Total crypto market capitalization stood at approximately $2.10 trillion, down 2.36% over 24 hours. The Altcoin Season Index was 58, indicating a neutral state, while the Fear and Greed Index was 12, indicating extreme fear. Open interest in Gate BTC and ETH USDT perpetual futures fell 0.24% and rose 4.91%, respectively, over the past 24 hours.
Top-Performing Tokens: INIT, BGSC and ELSA gained 61.54%, 34.49% and 24.59%, respectively, over the past 24 hours. INIT's hourly RSI was 76.27 and open interest in Gate USDT perpetual futures increased 133.63%, warranting continued attention to short-term retracement risks. BGSC and ELSA were approximately 3.81% and 14.06% below their respective highs for the period. Key factors to monitor include selling pressure near those highs, buying support near the lows and trading-volume confirmation.
Alpha Insights: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $5.39 billion in cumulative net outflows during November, exceeding the previous monthly record, although this was not the final monthly total. The U.S. strategic bitcoin reserve bill became eligible for a full House vote but had not taken effect and did not mandate additional bitcoin purchases. Switzerland approved 57 potential crypto tax information exchange partners, with information exchange planned from 2028 with eligible partners. CARF does not set a uniform tax rate and is not a ban on crypto trading.
